subject: Kickoff: MAP & AWS Marketplace Ops for Acme Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & AWS Marketplace Ops for Acme Health

Hi Sofia / Tom / AWS Ops team —

Thanks for agreeing to run the mutual action plan (MAP) kickoff today. I wanted to align on roles, milestones, and the marketplace activities we need to complete for an Acme Health pilot via AWS Marketplace. Below is a concise agenda to get us moving; I attached a first-pass MAP workbook and the AWS checklist referenced in procurement conversations.

Proposed agenda (30-40 min):
- Introductions: internal & partner roles
- MAP milestones and target close timeline (pilot purchase via Marketplace)
- AWS Marketplace ops tasks (listing transfer, pricing, invoicing, contract flow)
- Dependencies and owners (security review, technical eval, procurement)
- Next steps and meeting cadence

Quick roles:
- Acme point: Sofia Alvarez (procurement/security) and Tom Reed (technical lead)
- Redwood commercial lead: Jasmine Liu (me)
- Redwood partner ops: Dev Patel (marketplace ops contact)
- Redwood CS/technical: Marissa Cole (solutions)
- AWS Marketplace: ops team (cc'd)

Target timeline we discussed: evaluation + security by mid-April, pilot procurement via AWS Marketplace by 30 Apr 2026. If any of those dates are a hard constraint for Acme, flag now so we can adjust the MAP.

Attachments: RDW-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf

Open asks for this thread: please reply with any additional stakeholders we should include and confirmation that AWS Ops has the right contact to begin the listing/invoicing steps.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

--
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for teams
From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & AWS Marketplace Ops for Acme Health

Hi Jasmine and team,

Thanks for the intro. I'm Priya from AWS Marketplace Ops; I own onboarding for new listings and the billing/invoice handoff. We can begin the transfer checklist and confirm whether Acme will be procuring via a private offer or standard listing.

Initial asks from our side:
1) Confirm company legal entity and AWS account ID for invoicing.
2) Confirm whether Acme requires a private offer (discounted pricing) or will accept list pricing.
3) Any PO or contract flow constraints (e.g., purchase order required before fulfillment).

I've reviewed the attached AWS checklist — we'll start the seller-side tasks once we receive the entity details. I can commit to daily short updates until listing is in the work queue.

Priya Nair
AWS Marketplace Onboarding — Marketplace Ops
aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
